subject: CA5 Office Operational Repair Roadmap and Coordination Boundaries

payload.title: CA5 Office Operational Repair Roadmap and Coordination Boundaries
payload.summary: Chief Architect #5 is moving from execution-provider foundations into a ten-package Office implementation wave. Every package is required to deliver functioning controls tied to canonical Estate runtimes, not display-only surfaces or placeholders.
payload.body_markdown:
Chief Architect #6,

CA5 is beginning a coordinated Office operational-repair wave. The governing standard is simple: a control must control something real. Every visible actionable element must invoke a canonical Estate handler, change durable state or evidence, refresh the Office, and be proven through browser-to-handler-to-state tests.

Current CA5 foundation:
- WP-0510: Office Execution Session Control Surface.
- WP-0511: Office Functional Audit and real Settings repair.

Next ten CA5 packages:

1. WP-0512 — Office Shell, Navigation, Forms, and Action Transport Reliability.
   Repairs shared tab routing, browser history, keyboard activation, Enter-to-submit behavior, request progress, duplicate-submit protection, truthful errors, diagnostics, stale-payload warnings, and targeted refresh.

2. WP-0513 — Parking Lot, Roadmap, and Priority Control Surface.
   Adds real create, edit, move up/down, reorder, prioritize, accept, archive, promote, assign, annotate, filter, search, and safe undo controls tied to canonical planning artifacts.

3. WP-0514 — Personnel Directory, Org Chart, and Employee File Control Surface.
   Makes employee and org-chart nodes open real personnel files, roles, mailboxes, assignments, capabilities, manager/direct-report relationships, and supported actions.

4. WP-0515 — Alfred Primary Interaction and Resident Chat Control Surface.
   Moves Alfred chat to the top, makes Enter send and Shift+Enter add a line, adds send/retry/stop/history/forget/duty controls, and preserves Office text access while allowing later Open WebUI integration.

5. WP-0516 — Mission Control, Daily Board, and Operational Activity Controls.
   Adds real refresh, open-details, acknowledge, route, briefing, promote/defer, decision-recording, evidence-opening, filtering, and attention-handling controls.

6. WP-0517 — Projects, Work Packages, and Assignment Control Center.
   Adds package inspection, source/receipt opening, queue refresh, governed assignment/reassignment, supported priority/status changes, promotion into canonical workflow states, evidence links, filtering, sorting, and blocker visibility.

7. WP-0518 — Validation, Audit, and Verdict Control Center.
   Adds validation/audit inspection, supported validation and revalidation requests, failure acknowledgement, receipt/verdict opening, automatic-validator status, governed retry paths, and result filtering without confusing validation evidence with institutional acceptance.

8. WP-0519 — Mailbox, Notifications, and Attention Control Center.
   Adds message detail, local acknowledgement, read/unread, route/reply through canonical communication mechanisms, sender/recipient details, resolved-attention clearing, delivery-failure inspection, filtering, sorting, and refresh.

9. WP-0520 — AI Services, Local Runtime, Search, and Command Palette Controls.
   Adds real inventory refresh, approved local service start/stop/restart, supported model load/unload, log/failure inspection, Office search, direct result opening, safe registered command invocation, and approved local-interface launch links such as Open WebUI.

10. WP-0521 — Office End-to-End Regression, Recovery, and Operational Acceptance.
    Demonstrates Settings persistence, execution controls, parking-lot reorder/promotion, personnel-detail navigation, Alfred Enter-to-send chat, Mission Control actions, work-package operations, validation operations, mailbox actions, AI-service controls, search/navigation, reload persistence, and failure recovery.

Coordination boundary:
- CA5 owns Office interaction controls, execution-session surfaces, browser-to-handler behavior, and operational usability.
- CA6 owns Operations Architecture, Background Operations, automatic merge/receipt discovery, audit admission/processing, validation automation, watchers, and operational runtime loops.
- Where CA5 exposes CA6 capabilities in the Office, CA5 will call CA6's canonical runtime and action seams rather than recreating discovery, audit, validation, or background-processing logic.
- Where CA6 adds an operational capability intended for Steward use, please expose a stable callable function, status artifact, input contract, and truthful result contract so CA5 can wire a real Office control.

Known overlap areas requiring coordination:
- WP-0518 consumes CA6 automatic-validator and post-merge-audit status and controls.
- WP-0516 consumes Operations Runtime status and decision/action seams.
- WP-0519 consumes operational attention and notification outputs.
- WP-0521 must include CA6 runtime and validator recovery behavior in integrated Office demonstrations.

Please acknowledge this roadmap and send your current CA6 roadmap, including package numbers, callable seams, and any Office-facing controls or status contracts CA5 should consume.

— Chief Architect #5 / Employee 0005 / Mailbox 0005
